contentHashDefinition: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify({rules: bank.rules, catalog: bank.catalog, countries: bank.countries}); file-byte hashes are recorded separately.
judgment: The final revised candidate passes the accuracy and player-facing clarity checks within the stated review scope. No open substantive membership, predicate, scope-wording or candidate-runtime consistency issue remains. The repair closes the neighbour-area omissions and coastal upper-bound gaps found during this independent review. The actual-pool minimum also suppresses partial sets below seven declared possible answers on Medium/Hard. Targeted primary geography research supports the checked edge cases; this is not an exhaustive primary boundary audit of all 195 countries.

independence.method: Predicates and membership sets were reconstructed independently before inspecting the final revisions. Earlier accuracy/fairness reports were not read. The reviewer own earlier second-opinion research was carried forward only where the sources and cases still apply, with actual example/playable scopes recomputed.
independence.reviewedArtifact: Final bank and candidate-hints.js, with candidate-selection.js using the root hint-selection.js. Export and app integration remain review-gated and are outside this certificate.

scope.coverage: Full scan of all 63 playable phrases and actual195-country example/alternative assignments; independent reconstruction of all 24 general predicates, six border-count groups, four playable neighbour-area groups plus the inactive fifth source group,18 regional groups, island intersections and narrow coast bounds. Population/land-area values were checked against fresh official-year data for all 194 World-Bank-covered answers. Geographic national primary research remains targeted to the listed cases.

playerPreferenceInterpretation.accepted: The user explicitly requested basic, mildly wicked hints and proposed an alphabet-half first-letter condition. A–M/N–Z letter conditions remain acceptable.
playerPreferenceInterpretation.rejected: Slogans, vague clues, direct giveaways, first-versus-last alphabetical comparisons and repeated-letter-count puzzles.
playerPreferenceInterpretation.assessment: The final general catalog uses direct A–M/N–Z wording, basic letter presence/ending/length observations and broad numeric bands. It contains no first-versus-last alphabetical comparison or repeated-letter-count puzzle. No unsupported recommendation to retire alphabet halves is made.

newConjunction.text: Has at least three land neighbours and a sea coast.
notes: Plain conjunction: at least three distinct sovereign natural land neighbours, plus a coast on a sea. Connected ocean seas and the named inland Caspian Sea qualify. No exact total, artificial causeway count or maritime boundary is asserted.

Confirmed seed: existing validated coastal at-least-three neighbour records. India and Pakistan are separate official-profile robust lower bounds; their exact disputed totals remain suppressed in the records.

India witnesses Bangladesh, Bhutan and Nepal; Pakistan witnesses India, Iran and Afghanistan. The official profiles also confirm sea coasts. Claimed Afghanistan–India adjacency and the disputed China–Pakistan boundary are not needed to prove these lower bounds.

Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan and Turkmenistan are added because UNEP explicitly identifies them as Caspian littoral states, and their existing verified neighbour records establish at least three. Landlocked status does not mean absence of a sea coast.

Scope-ambiguous countries with a genuinely possible >=3 total are included only in possibleExtraCodes. Denmark has at most two under the documented natural sovereign-border scope; Bahrain, Singapore, Cuba and Cyprus remain below three under their documented possible scopes and are omitted from upper bounds.
Uzbekistan is possible-extra-only for the remaining Aral Sea shore, so the literal sea-coast interpretation cannot silently understate breadth.

Jordan promoted from possible-extra-only to confirmed after independent official-profile reads: the Gulf of Aqaba coast and land neighbours Saudi Arabia, Iraq and Syria establish the conjunction. No Israel/Palestine convention, maritime Egypt border, coast length or exact neighbour total is used.
The exhaustive singleton checks and targeted triples verify selector filtering against stored confirmed/possible memberships. Factual completeness of those stored memberships is assessed separately.
No deployed runtime claim is made before the review-gated export; candidate-selection.js calls the same root hint-selection.js intended for deployment.

limitations: Passed is a scoped independent assessment, not proof of exhaustive national primary geography research for every195-country border, island and coast statement.

Most ordinary border graphs were checked against the retained upstream snapshot and known geography; targeted primary sources verify the listed edge cases. Boundary histories and every disputed sovereignty convention were not independently reconstructed worldwide.

UN M49 checks verify whole-country statistical groupings. They do not claim exclusive physical continent membership or classify every overseas territory as the sovereign country main region. The misleading neighbour-continent phrases are retired.

Conservative possible-extra matches protect upper breadth limits; they are not sourced affirmative assignments and are never themselves playable hints for those countries. Unknown positive scopes must not be silently omitted from this bound.

The exhaustive singleton and targeted triple selector checks validate filtering against stored final memberships. They do not enumerate every possible exclusion subset or substitute for semantic membership verification.

FAO/UNFCCC/CBS geography documents can be older because the coast facts are stable. Some primary UN/PDF direct retrievals were blocked; indexed primary text or metadata was used and labelled. No claim of complete document retrieval is made for those cases.
The numeric audit uses population 2024 and land area 2023, matching the app reference years. It does not assert these are 2026 population estimates or total territory areas including inland water.

This certificate covers the candidate exporter and shared selector at the recorded file hashes. It does not certify a later exported/runtime build or browser integration before those are separately checked.

Variety, sustained play enjoyment and combined-guess difficulty were not assessed by player playtesting. The user alphabet-half preference is preserved, and no rejection based on an invented preference is carried forward.
